hook: Six seconds is all it took for a grandmaster to blunder.

sections.voiceover: Six seconds is all it took for a grandmaster to blunder.

In the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals, Teimour Radjabov faced Hikaru Nakamura. They played the Queen's Gambit Declined Three Knights Variation during their intense match-up. Does this 6 second time limit force Teimour Radjabov to make a fatal mistake?
Radjabov previously won a 3-1 match against Wesley So in round six of the tournament.
Radjabov made a losing move against Hikaru Nakamura because he only had 6 seconds left.
Only 6 seconds remained on the clock for Radjabov.
